text:
maria: CI is red on main — model-serving-smoke failing on linux-gpu-quant job 1589. Anyone available to bisect? failing test is `quantized_inference_smoke`, looks OOM-y around fused attention.
ci-bot: build 1589 failed: https://ci.redwood/builds/1589 — logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/1589/logs (exit code 137)
alek: I can take this. Rerun?
maria: rerun was attempted by CI but failure reproduces consistently on that job.
sam: quick context: last green on main was 1779983024 (commit 3a7f2c5). Suspect range includes PR#5138 (fused-kernel scheduling change) and PR#5141 (allocator tweak).
ravi: if it's scheduling-related, git bisect between 3a7f2c5 and HEAD and run the smoke in the quantized config. Might pinpoint the kernel default change.
maria: thanks. Alek, if you run bisect please paste the output.
alek: starting bisect now:
```
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git bisect start HEAD 3a7f2c5
git bisect run ./ci/run_smoke.sh --kernel-mode quantized --target linux-gpu-quant
```
Will update with results.
alek: first pass done — bisect narrowed it to commit 7a9c1b2 (PR 5138) that changed scheduler defaults for fused kernels. Reproduced locally on an RTX A5000 using container redwood/ci:2026-03-14.
alek: local reproducer snippet:
```
./build/serve --model tiny-quant --seq-len 1024 --batch 1 --kernel-sched default
# OOM at fused_attention.cu:123
```
jen: cc @infra — if PR 5138 tweaked kernel group sizes we should revert temporarily and run full CI to confirm.
maria: plan: Alek opens a revert PR that references this thread. If CI passes on revert we merge and then root-cause with PR owners.
alek: opened revert PR 5150: https://git.redwood/pulls/5150 — CI started (job 1591 queued).
ci-bot: build 1591 queued: linux-gpu-quant-0 — https://ci.redwood/builds/1591
sam: also propose adding a deterministic unit test for kernel-group boundaries to catch this class of regression.
ravi: agreed, I'll draft a test and a follow-up PR (5152) that adds a small boundary test and a doc note about kernel defaults.
maria: thanks all — Alek, keep this thread updated with CI status. If 1591 passes we'll merge revert and then escalate to owners of PR 5138. :thumbsup:
alek: will do, monitoring 1591 now.
jen: +1 — thanks for the quick triage everyone :rocket:
